summary: Six-phase plan (6h) for BL soundness by composition, transcribing the research report's prototype-verified Lean source. Phases 1-3 create Semantics/BLTruth.lean (native BLTruthAt + characterization lemmas), Semantics/BLValidity.lean (four validity predicates, Dedekind targeting BLValidDedekindDense), and Metalogic/BaseLanguageSoundness.lean (bridge proved by induction, four soundness theorems, four validity forms, two consistency corollaries, three native spot checks), each registered in its aggregator. Phases 4-5 run in parallel: Lean docstring amendments (directional BaseLanguage invariant, Conservativity.lean's four now-false claims, Truth.lean's stale reflexive note) and markdown inventory sync across six sites. Phase 6 is the full gate. Placement outside BaseLanguage/ keeps the module invariant literally true; the forbidden TruthAt-composed-with-tr design is guarded by an explicit grep check and the three spot checks.
